notes.title: Star Stuff DLC Soundtrack by Domestic BGM Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’re beyond excited to announce the launch of the Star Stuff Original Soundtrack DLC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232570/f89917c3d199f994f8e300fcb604b2945b394e90.jpg[/img]

Sound design has always been a fun and creative part of Star Stuff's development. A few of us have been long-time synth enthusiasts, and the idea of crafting a whole universe of sound was a dream. Early on, we dabbled in our own sound experiments, but soon realized we needed some extra hands to hit the quality we were aiming for (big shout-out to Harry, Rory, and Nicola for jumping in!).

When it came time to define the musical direction, we found ourselves constantly referencing tracks from Tasty Morsels, an independent music collective we loved. So, I took a chance and emailed a couple of the composers—turns out, they were interested! Harry and Rory, who were working on a new project called [url=https://domestic-bgm.org/retired-clown]Domestic BGM[/url], joined us for the soundtrack. Domestic BGM offers background music that is [i]actually[/i] good, and collaborating with them over the years has been a joy. Calls with Harry and Rory were some of my favorite moments—those guys are hilarious! For any developers reading this, take it as a sign: don’t hesitate to reach out to your dream collaborators!

Of course, none of this would have come together without the incredible [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicolapedroni/]Nicola Pedroni[/url], our brilliant audio director, who worked tirelessly to make sure the music and sound effects were perfectly balanced and of the highest quality. Huge thanks, Nicola!

We hope you enjoy every track and that it brings you deeper into the world of Star Stuff. Thanks for your ongoing support!

Here's more information on the [url=https://gleam.io/kInW0/star-stuffs-ost-now-available]giveaway[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232570/7f84d3c49a54130a9d095f645236d4b7cfe4509c.jpg[/img]

Love,
Sylvia 💫

notes.title: Game Devs of Color Expo features Star Stuff
notes.content:
Hi!

We're excited to announce that Star Stuff will be a part of the Game Devs of Color Expo! The Steam event will take place Sept 20th - Sept 30th. The online event will take place the 27th - 30th. If you haven't registered, check out their [url=https://www.gamedevsofcolorexpo.com/]website [/url]for more information! You will not be disappointed in the beautiful line up of speakers. 
 
And if you haven't checked out our updated demo, please do! The build is a complete graphical upgrade, including new editor UI, environments, characters, and animations. 

We hope you like it!

Already played the demo? Itching to get your hands on new puzzles? Please join our discord or contact sylvia@animogames.org to be a playtester for our alpha puzzle build. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232570/b7584d56bebb6f7f9faee3bcf44c507a0cbf0215.png[/img]

If you're new to Star Stuff, we're building a puzzle automation game that mixes bot programming with real-time shenanigans! Embrace the role of Stellar Systems Engineer, Mija (me-ha), a cosmic employee on their first day at a star factory. 

[i]Picture this: [/i] the fun of traversing a puzzle ‘room’ like in Portal or The Talos Principle meets the easy-to-use coding mechanic of Human Resource Machine or 7 Billion Humans. 

[h3]Features[/h3]
✨High-level but low-tension chill: Automate your bots with useful commands, see it pan out in real time and if you fail, just try again!
✨100+ hand-crafted, purposefully designed puzzles that get you thinking!
✨Stellar tunes to puzzle to: Enjoy tasty star-themed tracks that will help you focus and stay immersed in star factory life!

To stay updated on our progress and be the first to know about our latest developments, be sure to follow us on social media. And if you want to chat with us directly, join our Discord community for some 1:1 time!

notes.title: End-of-Year Update
notes.content:
We're continuing to make progress on Star Stuff and are excited to share some updates with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232570/a1fdf0da196b3aee812e6b9d435f779cffb0963b.png[/img]
[i]WIP red giant room 
[/i]
Art-wise, we're happy to report that a large portion of our assets are complete for every zone of the star factory. Patrick and César have also been working on an efficient system for our NPCs, allowing for a ton of variety with just three models that share the same rig. They've implemented retargeting with a humanoid rig to apply the same animation clips to all NPC models and have also added shader animation for the eyes and blend shapes for mouth animations. We're also experimenting with physics-based animations for NPC accessories, like wobbly alien ears!  

Our next priorities are to build out the design of our progression system and refine our gameplay assets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232570/27f803e88f1e967c0321dfdaa0d035798d73b188.png[/img]
[i]WIP NPCs aka your starlien crew
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232570/28dd07ae3189fb7069de4dc913ca9513919f9399.png[/img]
[i]WIP t-tauri terrace 
[/i]
On the level design front, we've validated the mechanics and concepts for Zones 0-5, and have tested Zones 0-2. We're planning to test Zone 3 levels soon after the new year. If you'd like to help us out by testing, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/rXEKSJR6]discord[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232570/474531180edc161ad2f364fb10687e89125f0c16.png[/img]
[i]grey box level, zone 2
[/i]
We've also been focusing on solidifying the story beats for the game. We're watching playtests and thinking about the right questions to ask ourselves to get players to their "aha!" moment. We're discussing the possibility of adding a light hint system to help players along. And, just for fun, we've been chatting with Chat GPT about star formation a lot these days. Ha!

Finally, we've made some changes to the game feel to improve the player experience. If you played our demo, you may have noticed that you couldn't move around to explore the puzzle before coding. We've changed this so that you can move freely and approach a terminal when you're ready to code. We hope this will allow you to jump in and try things out right away. Our coding editor is also getting a MAJOR facelift thanks to our UX designer, Martín.

We hope you're as excited about these updates as we are! As always, thanks for following along with our progress on Star Stuff.

Wishing you the best year yet!

Shine on, 
Sylvia & the rest of the Star Stuff team
